messages:
Sam P: Quick sync — we need to pick which SDK sample app set we prioritize for Q2. customer ask from Acme (billing) + internal quickstarts backlog. thoughts?
Anika R: +1 on focusing on billing sample, they've been pushing for an end-to-end example with Redwood Dedicated. want a shipable minimal app that shows: auth, pinned model, and fallback policy.
Liam T: Can we define success criteria before we scope? my suggestion: 1) Time-to-first-success < 10m, 2) CI passing on example repo, 3) <3 docs issues in first week.
Kai (DevEx): Also add: sample must include SDK + raw REST snippet, and a short reproducible eval (basic prompts + expected outputs). avoids "works only for devs" problem.
Marco - Eng: Engineering estimate: baseline sample (frontend + small express backend) ~2 sprints (3 people) for initial ship, +1 sprint for CI/docs polish. If we want IAC for Dedicated + env matrix that's extra.
Anika R: Customer-driven asks: Acme wants a step-by-step migration doc from hosted -> dedicated (networking + keys). Can we bundle that as a single "migration" section in sample app?
Sam P: Good call. Proposed MVP scope: 1) billing sample app, 2) migration appendix, 3) README quickstart, 4) one-liner Docker + `npm start`, 5) CI with example E2E smoke test.
Liam T: I can take the CI smoke test (playwright + record of the sample convo). I'll draft acceptance tests.
Kai (DevEx): I'll draft README and quickstart text. Suggest short checklist format so PMs/SAs can copy it into onboarding templates.
Marco - Eng: For Dedicated networking, I need a list of required infra pieces. @Anika R can you enumerate the corporate customer constraints (KMS, VPC flow logs)?
Anika R: Will do. I'll post a short doc with exact items by EOD.
deploy-bot: New PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/inference-samples/pull/412 — initial billing-sample scaffold (CI pending) :rocket:
Sam P: Decision: prioritize billing sample as "pick 1" for Q2 devex priority. Owners: Marco (eng), Kai (docs), Liam (tests), Anika (customer reqs). Action items: Marco create GH project + milestones; Kai produce README draft; Liam add smoke tests; Anika attach Acme networking checklist. Aim to have PR merged and basic CI passing by 1793530000 (~2 weeks).
Kai (DevEx): I'll also add a short telemetry/metrics section: adoption tracking (stars/clones), time-to-first-success (scripted), and a bug triage tag so we can measure maintenance cost.
Sam P: Perfect. I'll mark this as priority in the roadmap spreadsheet and add to next roadmap sync. :thumbsup:
